prerequisites: 005_discover_export_and_prepare_three.py produced a starter manifest with three real source-backed shard rows
each candidate has explicit row_no and parcel_id
each candidate has source-backed EPSG27700 coordinates or an exact canonical UPRN resolved through OS Open UPRN
current HMLR INSPIRE GML file for each candidate local authority is present
intersecting Environment Agency DTM 1m GeoTIFF tiles are present
matching OS Terrain 50 ASCII grid tile is present

execution_stages.name: HMLR_BOUNDARY_MATCH
execution_stages.acceptance: each candidate has an exact official-ID or unique point-in-polygon match

execution_stages.name: EA_DTM_AND_OS_TERRAIN50_SAMPLE
execution_stages.acceptance: minimum four valid EA cells and OS centroid cross-source difference at most 8m

execution_stages.name: WEBSITE_VERIFIED_EXAMPLE_PUBLICATION
execution_stages.acceptance: only HIGH or MEDIUM_HIGH official-source-crosschecked rows published

fail_closed_rules: no official identifier and no unique containment means reject
fuzzy or nearest UPRN join forbidden
fewer than four EA cells means reject
missing or ambiguous OS Terrain50 centroid cell means reject
cross-source absolute difference above 8m means reject
do not publish test fixtures or synthetic values
